integrity: Symbolic proof by second-order difference equation, exact inverse and compact-circle Fourier criterion. Independently replayed rational checks supplement rather than replace the proof. No external mathematical audit or publication-priority certification.
scientific_limitations: For the periodic Poisson spectrum r^{|n|}, real finite cosine masks with equally spaced harmonics and 0<r<1 only. Published priority remains best-knowledge; equivalent Green-function or Toeplitz terminology has not been exhaustively excluded.
title: Finite knot positivity cones for signed periodic Poisson covariances
